triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER core_v2_service_aggregate AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.itinerary_transport_services DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_trip_core_v2_aggregate()

triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER flight_service_aggregate_check_delete_v1 AFTER DELETE ON public.itinerary_transport_services DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.trip_id IS NULL)) EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_trip_flight_services()

triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER flight_service_aggregate_check_insert_v1 AFTER INSERT ON public.itinerary_transport_services DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.trip_id IS NULL)) EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_trip_flight_services()

triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER flight_service_aggregate_check_update_v1 AFTER UPDATE ON public.itinerary_transport_services DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.trip_id IS NULL)) EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_trip_flight_services()

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER transport_service_row_guard_delete_v1 BEFORE DELETE ON public.itinerary_transport_services FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.trip_id IS NULL)) EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_trip_import_services()

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER transport_service_row_guard_insert_v1 BEFORE INSERT ON public.itinerary_transport_services FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.trip_id IS NULL)) EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_trip_import_services()

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER transport_service_row_guard_update_v1 BEFORE UPDATE ON public.itinerary_transport_services FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.trip_id IS NULL) OR (new.trip_id IS NULL))) EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_trip_import_services()
